notes: Source names read on 2026-11-08 from a real Meshy auto-rig (meshy_rig, rigging task output Character_output.glb and Animation_Walking_withSkin.glb), imported in Blender 5.2.3: Hips > Spine02 > Spine01 > Spine > neck > Head (+ head_end, headfront leaves), Left/Right Shoulder > Arm > ForeArm > Hand, Left/Right UpLeg > Leg > Foot > ToeBase. Note the spine order: Spine02 is next to the hips, Spine is the chest.

The glTF import gives the armature object a 0.01 scale (bone data in centimetres); retarget works in world space, so apply or keep it, but do not mix a 0.01 source with a target whose transforms were applied differently without checking a frame.
Target names: DEF bones of a Rigify rig generated from the basic human metarig (same set as mixamo_to_rigify.json). head_end and headfront are leaves with no target and are listed as unmapped.
